summary:
I mapped pull request 2's part of the two-player and catch code in src/engine.js and checked the map with a patched scratch copy: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-rex-strength-lab/be83ea46-0fb6-5f45-86e4-061daa8f7429/scratchpad/understand2/engine-pr2.js, built by patch.js in the same folder. Nothing under rex-strength-lab/ was edited. All numbers below use the 3,000 kg bodies on main.

Powers off is untouched. I ran the two-player, catch, toss and throw cases from test/powers-off-cases.js through the original and patched engines, both with the powers left out and with OFF: 11,120 runs, 0 hashes differ. That holds because every new branch is guarded on a truthy ownRecoil, and new keys (recoilAbsorbed, recoilT, recoilC) appear only with the power on. Part 1's canon() hashes every key, so a new key on the powers-off path would break the fixture.

The core pattern for each site:
- With ownRecoil on, report the push back as an ocean figure, a magnitude J ≥ 0 with T and a direction.
- With ownRecoil off and Unbreakable footing on, keep today's toGround path unchanged.
- The catcher uses ownAnchor(ctxC), so he stays planted (Q5).

The patched engine gives the brief's "new" column:
- Shove: the same shove (Ollie at 21.1 m/s, sliding 36.7 m). Nothing goes into the ground; recoilAbsorbed is 66,743 kg·m/s.
- Fastball, 10 m apart at a 10⁹ kg dial: recoilT and recoilC are both 3,249 kg·m/s, nothing goes into the ground, and the catcher doesn't slide.
- Fastball at a 10²⁰ kg dial: the catcher is no longer carried off.
- Partner toss: recoilT and recoilC are 42,040 kg·m/s (easy) or 62,400 kg·m/s (hard).
- Arm wrestle pin: with Unbreakable footing on, it now hands the ground the slam at any swing time.

Collide stays as it is. fireballAt's push is left for pull request 4. liftPartner, recoilOf, easyPush and throwPushJ need no code change (throwPushJ and its comment just lose their recoil case). There are three traps:
- If only throwOnce changes, leg and tossPartner still emit a toGroundT through throwPushJ's easyPush fallback, which gives vToMomentum(vL).
- The arm pin's existing J = vToMomentum(v, M) is wrong near light speed. Pull request 2 is the first to reach that path.
- Planting the catcher raises the arm force he needs. Some catches flip from 'caught' to 'slams', for example a bus thrown hard 10 m apart at the default dial.

Several tests the brief doesn't list must change: powers.js:171, :371, :390, :461, :466, :476 (toss part) and :520 (throwPartner part); shots.js:527 (shove and catch); shots.js:199-200 if the page's shakeOnly wording changes. I reproduced each of the powers.js ones against the patched engine, and the fixes I name pass there. The shots.js ones follow from reading the code; I didn't run shots.js.

summary:
I mapped every place where a single-player move in src/engine.js sends Rex's own recoil into the planet, plus the code around ownAnchor and weakGround. I didn't edit the repo. To test the plan I built a patched copy of the engine in scratch (patch.js writes engine-new.js under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-rex-strength-lab/be83ea46-0fb6-5f45-86e4-061daa8f7429/scratchpad/understand2/).

1. **Powers off is safe.** Every case in test/fixtures/powers-off.json still matches with the patch: 31,082 runs, each case once with the powers left out and once explicitly off, 0 differences (offcheck.js). The patch adds new keys only when ctx.ownRecoil is set. The fixture hashes whole result objects, so a new key on a powers-off result would break part 1.

2. **The patch closes the momentum ledger.** I checked every solo move: throw at 0°, 45° and 90°, stomp, punch at the push's end, clap, jump and pull. Each ran with six power sets (all on, all off, own recoil only, Unbreakable only, Unbreakable and bolted, all on and bolted) at three dials. Every total is within 2.2e-16 of zero (ledger2.js).

3. **The brief's figures reproduce.** The least-disruptive car is thrown at 22,100 kg-force:
   - Today: toGround J is 22,020 kg·m/s over 0.247 s, shaking the ground 0.43 mm/s at 5 m; the landing gives 1.18 mm/s.
   - Patched: recoilAbsorbed is 22,020 kg·m/s, there is no toGround, and the landing alone gives 1.18 mm/s.

4. **The real code changes are small:**
   - **throwOnce:** with own recoil on, report recoilAbsorbed instead of toGround.
   - **MOVES.throw.shake and shakeFrom:** count his push only with Unbreakable footing on and own recoil off.
   - **stompOnce:** report recoilAbsorbed equal to the foot's push momentum (push.pB), upward.
   - **punchOnce:** optionally report recoilAbsorbed equal to push.pB; the arm's stop hands it back, so the net is 0.
   - **pull:** report recoilAbsorbed equal to the rope force times the 10 m time (ropeT × t10m), backward.
   - **MOVES.pull:** delete shake and shakeWithPower.
   - **weakGround:** test ctx.anchor === 'bolted' instead of ownAnchor(ctx).

5. **Four gates outside the solo scope are needed too.** The Catch code reads the throw's toGround or calls throwPushJ, so the thrower's push, the toss, both catches, and shoveOnce each need an `unbreakable && !ownRecoil` gate. The trap: throwPushJ's full-strength path silently falls back to easyPush when r.toGround is missing.

6. **Clap, jump and sprint don't read ownRecoil.** The jump only gains airLoss through anyPower, as today.

7. **Three findings the brief doesn't have:**
   - **His feet still carry his recoil.** throwOnce counts the push's downward part in the load on his feet (Nfeet, sinkRatio, sinkRatioRaw) even with the power on. At a 10⁹ kg dial that causes the "drives his feet down 1,505×" page text, the ground hazard at 650,000 kg-force with only own recoil on, and the default page's "break the ground" preset at 650,200 kg-force. This needs a decision.
   - **The brief's ceiling claim is wrong for heavy objects.** It says the ceiling and presets don't move because the landing always shook harder. For heavy objects his push set them, so they move.
   - **Some test moves in the brief would change what those tests check.** Two of the round-4/5 throw checks need `anchor: 'bolted'`, not only `ownRecoil: false`, or the sideways part gets capped by friction.

ledger:
Push-phase momentum ledger per solo move. Axes: x = the throw's or pull's horizontal direction, y = up; weights are measured from the static state. Checked on a patched scratch engine for six power sets (all on, all off, own recoil only, Unbreakable only, Unbreakable + bolted, all on + bolted) × dials (90,718.474 kg-force, 10⁹ kg, 10¹² kg). Every total is ≤ 2.2e-16 of the largest term (ledger2.js).

THROW (car), at the end of the push and follow-through. Object +pObj·û, where pObj = push.pB·m_obj/mB; the arm's momentum (push.pB·armMass/mB) is handed back to his body.
- His body: -pRecoil·û, where pRecoil = max(0, push.pA - pArm). It is 0 whenever own recoil is on.
- The ground:
  - toGround is reported only today with (ownRecoil || unbreakable), and after the change only with unbreakable && !ownRecoil.
  - Direction is implicit: back along û (x = -J cos θ, y = -J sin θ).
  - When capped, weakGround also gives whole, sideTaken, suppliedSide and suppliedDown. The ground's share is (-sideTaken, -(whole sin θ - suppliedDown)) and the ocean's weak-ground share is (-suppliedSide, -suppliedDown).
  - With the powers off the ground's share isn't reported; derive it as -(pObj - pRecoil)·û.
- The ocean (new): recoilAbsorbed.J = pObj back along û.
- Example: least-disruptive car at 45°. Today: ground 22,020 kg·m/s (x -15,570, y -15,570), ocean 0. New: ocean 22,020 back along 45°, ground 0.
- Example: all-out car at 10¹² kg, 45°. Today: ground sideways 9.91e7 and down 9.68e4, ocean (weak ground, down) 9.90e7. New: ocean 1.401e8 back along 45° (x and y each -9.905e7), ground 0.
- Figures to add: recoilAbsorbed {J, T}, with a guard on cos θ at 90°. pObj and pRecoil are locals today but can be recovered from push, mB and armMass.

STOMP (y). Foot -push.pB (then stopped by the ground: the blow, -pB).
- Body: +push.pA, net of gravity.
- Standing foot (powers off): +(pB - pA). This is the unloading or lift; with Bolted (no power) it is +pB, the bolts pulling the planet up. Not reported.
- New with own recoil: ocean +push.pB (up), standing foot 0, and nothing cancels the blow.

ledger:
The ledger at the end of the push, along the throw line (th) and then split into a sideways axis x and an up axis y. The terms are the object (+pObj), his body (−pRecoil, 0 when bolted), the ground and the ocean.

**Throw**
- **Powers off:** the engine reports no toGround. The ground's share is computed in the test as pObj − pRecoil, along th, pointing backward. Adding a field here would break the fingerprints in test/powers-off-cases.js, which hash every key.
- **Unbreakable footing on, They take their own recoil off:** toGround.J = pObj − pRecoil. Where weakGround caps it, it returns sideTaken (Jhg), J = hypot(Jhg, Jdg), suppliedSide and suppliedDown. Add downTaken (Jdg) so the axes need no square root; it exists only with Unbreakable on. The ocean's share is suppliedSide on x and suppliedDown on y; this is canon's 'the ground's share it can't bear'.
- **They take their own recoil on (new):** no toGround. A new recoilAbsorbed = { J: pObj, th, T } (or x = −J cos th, y = −J sin th) is the ocean's share, canon's 'their own recoil'. The arm's momentum (pB·armMass/mB) comes back inside him through the follow-through, so it adds nothing. Report it only under ctx.ownRecoil.
- **Figures:** least car at 45°: old ground (−15,570, −15,570); new ocean (−15,570, −15,570) kg·m/s. All-out car at 10¹² kg: old ground (−9.90 × 10⁷, small) plus ocean (0, −9.90 × 10⁷), supplied; new ocean (−9.90 × 10⁷, −9.90 × 10⁷).
- **Unbounded push:** pObj Infinity, so J Infinity. The ledger test needs an 'unbounded on both sides' rule there instead of a sum.

**Pull (new):** recoilAbsorbed = { J: vToMomentum(vEnd, obj.m) + resist·t10m, T: t10m }, pointing backward (the figure pull.shake used). His own walk on friction stays in the ground: his body's momentum is the move, not recoil.

**Jump:** pushOff { J, whole, supplied } as now. The comic unlimited jump has J 0, T 0 and supplied Infinity: the ground's share it can't bear (Q9).

**Air:** the drag share is flight.ocean.P.

**Setup.**
- Bodies: P.makeBody({ build, ...P.DEFAULT_BODIES[build] }) (3,000 kg).
- Context: { F: kg*g, mode: 'comic', surface: concrete, anchor: 'friction' }.
- Power states: ON (all four), OFF ({}), plus UB-only and OR-only, to show where each share comes from.
- Dials: 90,718 kg (the page default), 1e9 kg and 1e12 kg. Growth uses E = 1e6, 1e15 and 4.2e23 J.
- Axes: x is forward along his push, y is up. Each entry is the momentum a party receives, labelled as one of: object, body, partner, ground, weight (Earth's pull during the push), ocean:recoil, ocean:supplied, ocean:air, ocean:growthLift.

**The rows, and what the engine gives today.**

*Throw, car at 0, 45 and 90 deg.*
- Object: +p along th. Use push.pB*m/mB, or from Eobj near light speed: p = sqrt(E^2 + 2Emc^2)/c. Rounding of r.v makes vToMomentum(r.v) inexact near c.
- Body: -vToMomentum(recoilV, M) along th.
- Ground: from toGround. If uncapped, -whole along th. If capped, the ground takes (-sideTaken, -(whole sin th - suppliedDown)) and the ocean's supplied part is (-suppliedSide, -suppliedDown).
- New: ocean:recoil = -recoilAbsorbed.J along th.
- Today ON/UB/OR close to about 1e-16, because toGround is defined as pObj - pRecoil. OFF has no ground figure: the planet's share is 9% (0 deg), 95% (45 deg) and 100% (90 deg) at the default dial.

*Stomp.*
- Foot: -push.pB in y, into the ground. Body: +vToMomentum(vBody) in y. Weight: +m_A g push.t, booked only while he rises.
- OFF and UB close to about 1e-16.
- ON and OR leave 100% unreported: the standing foot's pull into the planet is not a figure.
- New: ocean:recoil = +push.pB up.

**The checks.**
1. Closure: |Σ entries| ≤ 1e-6 × max|entry|. Exceptions: the catch thrower (use the exact throw) and the Collide not-held bounce (fix toGround, or exempt with a reason).
2. Powers OFF: no ocean entry except ocean:growthLift. Optionally, the unreported remainder must point the right way (backward/down for a throw, ground pushes only).
3. Powers ON:
   - Every ocean entry is a canon case: air, supplied, growthLift, recoil, and later 'hit' for PR 4.
   - With ownRecoil on, each of the throw, stomp, pull, shove, wrestle-throw push, catch throw, catch stop, toss and toss catch has an ocean:recoil entry equal to its push back (the object's momentum; push.pB; ropeT·t10m; Jfeet; pIn).
   - No toGround, toGroundT or toGroundC comes from his own push.
   - Without this guard, a mutant that moves the recoil back into toGround and drops recoilAbsorbed still closes the sum. This guard is what makes each round-2 mutant fail.
4. ON and OFF results for each row are reported side by side, so the Old/New of the brief (22,000 kg·m/s at the default dial; 9.9e7 + 9.9e7 at 1e12, which becomes 1.4e8 in the ocean) are asserted.

**Cost.** About 1-2 s, so it is safe within CI's 20-minute timeout. --skip-off (line 16) runs it without part 1's 31,082 hashes.
